title: EzWebsAndGaps
description: Easy plugin that adds cheaper crafting recipes for golden apples and cobwebs
body:
Easy plugin that adds cheaper crafting recipes for golden apples and cobwebs.
Features:
•
Golden apples craft with 4 gold ingots and 1 apple
•
Golden apple recipe gives 2 golden apples
•
Cobwebs craft with string in an X shape
•
Cobweb recipe gives 2 cobwebs
•
Replaces the normal 8-gold golden apple recipe
Made by Flompy3.
